application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
description: Erection of a single storey rear infill and rear extension to the house and renovations to the house's existing front elevation.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications:  A100 (Rev P3); A150 (Rev P4); A160 (Rev P5) Received:  19 May 2023;  A5 (Rev P1); A10 (Rev P1); A11 (Rev P1); A15 (Rev P1); A95 (Rev P1); A110 (Rev P1) Received:  02 February 2023.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the single storey rear infill and rear extension hereby approved.
